title: Filter access prerequisite checkboxes by assessment type: LAN-specific options must not appear on web/API scans
goal: The mission preview step shows 'What access or prerequisites do you already have?' with six checkboxes. For an External Web scan, the following LAN-specific options appear incorrectly: 'No credentials available (Unauthenticated LAN lane)' and 'Intrusive LAN checks authorised (Intrusive LAN phase)'. These options are only meaningful for Internal LAN / AD assessments. Gate each prerequisite checkbox by the selected assessment tile(s): web-only tiles (external-web, api-security, ssl-tls, llm-ai-app) must only show web-relevant prerequisites (no credentials / credential info available / API key available). LAN/AD tiles (internal-lan, active-directory, full-internal) show the full set. In wizard.js, find the ACCESS_UNLOCKER_OPTIONS array and add an 'appliesTo' or 'tileKeys' filter field, then filter the rendered checkboxes based on selected tiles.
scope: Live wizard audit 2026-05-01: External Web preview shows 'Unauthenticated LAN lane' and 'Intrusive LAN checks authorised' — both are LAN-specific concepts that confuse web scan operators. Screenshots in ui/test-results/wizard-complete-2026-05-01/external-web-s3-preview.png confirm the issue.
generation_reason: Live audit 2026-05-01: LAN-specific access prerequisites ('Unauthenticated LAN lane', 'Intrusive LAN checks authorised') show on External Web preview — confusing for web scan operators.
